The *Kilesajahanakathā* ("Discussion on the Abandoning of Defilements") is a debate text in the nineteenth chapter of the *Kathāvatthu*, the fifth book of the Theravāda *Abhidhamma Piṭaka* [SuttaCentral]. As with other sections of the *Kathāvatthu*, it employs a dialectical format to examine doctrinal points concerning Buddhist psychology and soteriology, specifically addressing questions related to the overcoming or abandonment (*pahāna* / *jahana*) of the defilements (*kilesa*) [SuttaCentral; DharmaNexus]. SuttaCentral identifies one modern translation of the text [SuttaCentral].
